The **FHIR IG Publisher** is HL7's tool that turns an implementation guide's
sources into a published site. Here it is a *mechanical actor*: a process
step with declared inputs and outputs.

In a build with pre- and post-processing it is **one step among many**. API
sidecars, JSON Schemas and JSON-LD vocabularies on a published IG are written
by scripts *after* it exits, not by the Publisher.

## How the harness runs it
{: #how-the-harness-runs-it data-fa-label="sec:ig-publisher-how-the-harness-runs-it" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/how-the-harness-runs-it.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/how-the-harness-runs-it.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/how-the-harness-runs-it.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="how-the-harness-runs-it.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/how-the-harness-runs-it.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="how-the-harness-runs-it.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/how-the-harness-runs-it.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

The harness runs the Publisher **once per AST**, not once per site build:

- `ig-ast-build.sh` (the checkout script `prepare:fhir-harness`) and the
  reusable `ig-ast-refresh.yml` run `AstExportCli`, an entry point added to a
  fork of the Publisher ([litlfred/fhir-ig-publisher](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-ig-publisher)).
  The fork is pinned by its `ast-export` commit. The run writes `output-ast/`,
  one JSON dump per resource.
- The site is then rendered **from the AST**, never from the Publisher's
  `output/` HTML. No Publisher runs while a site is published.
- An IG with no `index.config.json`, or a run with `--bare-ig`, takes the
  **bare** route instead: the IG's own `ghbuild.yml` steps run, and the
  Publisher's output is published as it is.

How to run each route: [Render an IG from the command line](run-locally.html).
How the result is deployed: [Publishing an IG](publishing.html).

## What one run emits
{: #what-it-emits data-fa-label="sec:ig-publisher-what-it-emits" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/what-it-emits.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/what-it-emits.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/what-it-emits.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="what-it-emits.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/what-it-emits.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="what-it-emits.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/what-it-emits.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

| output | notes |
|---|---|
| `output/` | the rendered site: HTML per resource and per page (`input/pagecontent/`, `sushi-config.yaml` `pages:`) |
| `{ResourceType}-{id}.json` | the structured surface everything downstream reads |
| `.xml`, `.ttl` | the same resource in two more serialisations; this platform reads only the JSON |
| `package.tgz` → `package/.index.json` | filename, `resourceType`, `id` (index version 2) |
| `canonicals.json`, `package.manifest.json` | partial views of the artefact set |
| `artifacts.html` | the **only** source of an artefact's category |
| `qa.json` | the validation record |
| POT files | translatable strings |

The list changes between releases and the version is not pinned (below), so
any count needs a date and a version.

**It emits no artefact index.** `ValueSets.schema.json` is a schema whose
`example` happens to hold a list; it is not an index. An index must be
**reconstructed** from the four partial views above, and provenance records
all four because which one matters differs per IG.

## What only it can do
{: #what-only-it-can-do data-fa-label="sec:ig-publisher-what-only-it-can-do" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/what-only-it-can-do.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/what-only-it-can-do.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/what-only-it-can-do.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="what-only-it-can-do.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/what-only-it-can-do.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="what-only-it-can-do.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/what-only-it-can-do.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

1. **Profile validation**: every resource against its profiles and FHIR version.
2. **Dependency-closure resolution** with version pinning (for a clinical
   guideline IG: `hl7.terminology`, `hl7.fhir.uv.extensions.r4`,
   `hl7.fhir.uv.cql`, `hl7.fhir.uv.cpg`, `hl7.fhir.uv.crmi`, `hl7.fhir.uv.sdc`).
3. **Terminology expansion** against a terminology server.

None can be recomputed from its output, so a cached build is a *cache*: its
indices, dependency edges and versions were true when it was written.

**Expansion fails quietly.** Against a dead or restricted terminology server
there are fewer expansions and the consuming steps warn and continue. A thin
vocabulary is not evidence of a thin `ValueSet`; check that expansion ran.

## What it cannot tell you
{: #what-it-cannot-be-asked-for data-fa-label="sec:ig-publisher-what-it-cannot-be-asked-for" }

Its metadata exports, measured on two IGs:

| export | trust IG | immunizations IG |
|---|---|---|
| `valueset-ref-list.json` ValueSet→CodeSystem edges | 17 over 14 | 431 over 252 |
| `codesystem-ref-list.json` `uses` populated | 0 of 15 | 0 of 14 |
| `usage-stats.json` extension→path | 6 | 35 (+5 profiles) |

- **`uses` is declared but never populated**, so "no dependencies" and "not
  computed" look the same.
- **No dependencies among `Library`, `PlanDefinition` or `Measure`.** In the
  immunizations IG that is 279 + 138 + 41 artefacts, about **61 %**: the CQL
  and decision logic.

The exports reach terminology, not logic. Logic dependencies need an AST
emitted by the tool itself, which means changing `org.hl7.fhir.core`, not only
the Publisher. Re-measure before quoting: a release can close either gap.

## The version is not pinned
{: #the-version-floats data-fa-label="sec:ig-publisher-the-version-floats" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/fhir-harness/edit/main/docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/the-version-floats.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/the-version-floats.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/fhir-ig-publisher/the-version-floats.md" data-repo="litlfred/fhir-harness" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="the-version-floats.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/the-version-floats.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="the-version-floats.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/the-version-floats.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/fhir-harness/fhir-ig-publisher/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

A common build fetches the **latest** `publisher.jar` on every run:

```yaml
- name: Update the image to the latest publisher
  uses: docker://hl7fhir/ig-publisher-base:latest
  with:
    args: curl -L https://github.com/HL7/fhir-ig-publisher/releases/latest/download/publisher.jar …
```

Two builds of the same commit can differ, and the output does not say which
version made it, so "the build changed" cannot be told from "the content
changed". A cached AST must therefore record its toolchain (Publisher, core and
SUSHI versions) as a required field.

The rules are skills; where a skill and this page disagree, the skill wins.

- **`ig-publication`**: the run, and who authorises versus manages a release.
- **`ig-build-pipeline`**: the bare pipeline and what it refuses to know.
- **`ig-publisher-reduction`**: the phased move to a Publisher run only for an AST and QA record.
- **`ig-publisher-fork`**: the experimental fork, and what an AST must carry.
